match_id: DE ZERBI: “RICHARLISON AND DANSO? THEY CAN GO!”  Tottenham_Newcastle ⚽ Premier League_2026-08-29_cMUDLEFHGdo
team: DE ZERBI: “RICHARLISON AND DANSO? THEY CAN GO!”  Tottenham
quote_text:
Good evening. Good evening. I’m sorry. Hi,  Roberto. Did the... I mean, how frustrating  
was it for you, the play in the final third  today for Spurs? They’d kind of got in and  
around the goal but never looked like scoring. No,  I’m disappointed for the result, and I’m sorry for  
the fans, for the environment now, because after  two defeats maybe somebody can think it’s the same  
history, the same as the last two seasons.  I have no doubt. It’s not like this. I think  
I can’t change my opinion after two defeats. I  have big, big confidence in the qualities of my  
players. At the end, when we become a team, when  we improve the connection between the players,  
when we improve the quality of the play, when we  improve the defensive phase, the distance between  
the attackers, defenders, midfielders, when  we create a team, this group, with me or with  
another coach, nothing changes, because they are  too good players. I’m sorry for the club because,  
anyway, they are building a great squad.  But maybe now we are not ready yet for many,  
many reasons. We are not ready yet for many  reasons. But today, I think until the first goal,  
we played better than Newcastle. Newcastle  are a good team. Good coach, good players,  
good everything. But we created more chances to  score. We shot more times. We had more control of  
the ball than Newcastle. We suffered too much in  two, three situations in the first half because  
the distance between the attackers and defenders  was too big, too much space. And then, after the  
goal we conceded, I think we lost the confidence.  The reaction was not good enough. Not the reaction  
I want to see on the pitch. And I said immediately  after the end of the game to the players, because  
when you are building something new, it’s  tough. There are problems. The difference is  
how you want to find the solution to these  problems. And the solution is not to pull down  
the head, but to react, because we had 20 minutes  again to score one, two, maybe three goals. So,  
do you want to sign one more player in a specific  position before the transfer window shuts? Is that  
an attacker? No, we speak about the game. Today  is not the right moment, the right day to...  
Otherwise, it’s like an excuse. No, no excuse.  No, I don’t want excuses. I want to say I believe  
more than the Brentford game in our project.  I believe in our players. I think Marmoush,  
for the first game, played very well. It was the  first game for Micky van de Ven and Pedro Porro.  
They came late and they are crucial for this  team, after the World Cup, after two injuries.  
Sandro Tonali is another crucial player. He is not  in the right condition, in the best condition yet,  
maybe physically, even if he worked with us  at the beginning of pre-season. Yeah, I think  
if I was positive last season when we were in  the Championship, because when I came we were  
in the Championship, what do you think my thoughts  now could be? Can I just ask you very quickly,  
just on your squad, really? You had no  Richarlison, Sarr or Danso. Richarlison?  
I don’t know. He said too many times he wants  to leave. Danso came to me two days ago too,  
and he said he wants to leave. And the other  player, Pape Sarr, the same, but he suffered  
a small injury but is almost ready to train.  And Savinho was another tough player who didn’t  
play. After the press conference, the medical  staff came to me yesterday to inform me Savinho  
didn’t feel good. A small muscular problem.  Maybe Monday or Tuesday he can restart with us,  
but the medical staff didn’t want to take any risk  with him, especially because he didn’t work and he  
didn’t train in the last 15 days with Man City,  and so... Hi, Roberto. You spoke a lot last season  
about the mentality of the team. It feels like  last week they conceded one goal, heads down.  
Today again, conceded... You are right. Is this  the biggest problem for you, the mentality? Yeah,  
you are right. Yes, for sure. How do you improve  that? It is the biggest problem, it is the biggest  
challenge, it is the biggest target, to find the  right mentality. Unfortunately, you can’t buy the  
mentality in the transfer market or putting many  players inside. Football is like a magic thing.  
You can change many players in a window, in one  window of the transfer market, and you can find  
the balance immediately or you need more time.  I think we achieve this target, we achieve this  
goal. I would like to achieve this target quickly,  as soon as possible, because it is crucial to play  
football. But the plan, the project of the club,  what we are doing to build, to rebuild a new team  
with new players, is a great plan, is a great  project. And I have no doubt about the result  
of this project. We have to accept and to be  stronger, to move on after this defeat. And,  
you know, connected to that... I think in  the first half, if we scored two goals today,  
now we would be talking about different things.  Unfortunately, we lost the game. And you know,  
in Italian, who wins celebrates and who loses  explains why. And I’m explaining why. Roberto,  
those players who tell you they want to leave,  what’s your message to them? And is there any way  
back? I love, I love these players. They are two  great guys. I have a very good relationship. But  
if they want to leave, they have to bring  the solution, the economic solution, to the  
club. And they can go and we find other players.  Charlie, last one, please. You mentioned Tonali.  
Very difficult game for him. How disappointed were  you for him, with all the Newcastle fans booing  
him and his role in the goal when he was turned  and obviously they scored? Were you disappointed  
with that? No. I love Sandro Tonali. Today is the  day where my emotion for my players is bigger than  
the other days, because we are building together.  The club, Vinai, Johan Lange, the owner, me. And  
they are like our children. So this day is so sad,  no? So we are all of us very disappointed for the  
result. But I love my players more today than the  next win we will make. Okay. Thank you. Thank you.
